$comment: Single source of truth for the SynOI Decision Receipt canonical signing field list -- the exact field set that participates in the Ed25519 / hybrid ML-DSA signature seal, under omit-when-absent semantics (a field missing or null is excluded from the canonical form, not an error, EXCEPT the legacy_required_fields below, which a signer/verifier may treat as hard-required). Consumed by synoi-gateway (src/verify-router.ts CANONICAL_FIELDS) and synoi-control (src/receipts/verify-signature.ts CANONICAL_FIELDS + OPTIONAL_CANONICAL_FIELDS). Both repos vendor their own runtime copy of this list as a literal array -- gateway is a long-running service, control is an AWS Lambda deploy, neither can read a sibling repo's directory at runtime -- so this file is read at TEST time only, by a drift-tripwire test in each repo's suite that fails CI when a repo's vendored copy falls out of parity with this list. Do not add a field here without updating BOTH repos' vendored copies in the same change.
hybrid_required_note: Whether the RECEIPT SIGNATURE SCHEME requires the ML-DSA-65 hybrid component to be present for a receipt to verify (not a per-field flag). Currently false: an Ed25519-only signature is still accepted for pre-K1 receipts. Gateway's own cutover check (isPostCutoverDowngrade, src/verify-router.ts) already hard-fails a post-K1 Ed25519-only receipt at the gateway's own /verify surface. synoi-control currently verifies Ed25519 only at its ingest gate (src/receipts/verify-signature.ts, documented, deliberately out of scope for the canonical-field-drift fix that added this file) -- ML-DSA-65 verification at the control ingest gate is a separate follow-up. When that ships, flip this flag to true and update control's verifyReceiptBlob to also check ml_dsa_signature.
